purpose: Probe role selection from descriptions, not task execution quality or real deployment frequency.
selector: Six fresh default subagents; current session default is GPT-6 Astra medium. No conversation history is forked.

conditions.b: Role portraits clarify lightweight operator, versatile worker, and regularly consulted professor.
conditions.c: Current descriptions with only godlike added to kami.

ordering: Run 1 follows file order; run 2 reverses both scenario and catalog order.
interpretation: Preferred roles express the user intent as interpreted by the parent, not an objective answer key; roles may overlap.
limits: Only names and descriptions are provided; model settings and child instructions are omitted.
All work items are assumed worth delegating to isolate role choice.
Synthetic cases and two runs per condition do not estimate real-world usage rates.
The parent authored cases and alternatives; the selectors are context-isolated but retain normal runtime instructions.

boundary_followup.reason: The first 16 distinct scenarios produced identical first choices in all six runs; subtler everyday cases remain unresolved.
boundary_followup.expectations: No single correct role is prescribed. Compare ambiguity, role overlap, and changes across descriptions.
boundary_followup.selector_context: Continue the same six selectors with their own prior choices, without sharing any other results or expected answers.
boundary_followup.ordering: Replicate 1 uses file order; replicate 2 reverses it.
boundary_followup.timing: Cases were written after examining the first-stage results and before any boundary results.
